name: Real recurrence data and denominators (live ledger audit)
summary: The live bicz ledger shows real recurrence: 15 canonical lessons 2026-10-12..10-24, with follow_explicit_instruction violated 7 times across 12 days (repeat counts 0..5) and finish_the_job showing the only repeat-multiplier escalation (omp, mult 1->2, 10,000,000 + 10,000,000 mc applied). But no eligible-opportunity denominator artifact exists anywhere: the ledger records 89,948 per-call spend events and 46,517 reservations, never aggregated into per-window opportunity counts, so no recurrence rate can be computed today. Denominator definitions are proposed as design guidance, not claims.

claim_and_evidence.outline_claim_verbatim: '15 canonical lessons 2026-10-12..10-24; follow_explicit_instruction violated 7x across 12 days. Repeats exist; recurrence-rate claims need eligible-opportunity denominators per time window, which no current artifact provides.'
claim_and_evidence.ledger_lessons_verified: lessons table: 15 rows (jakubsikora 12, omp 3), all confirmed_breach, all self_disclosed=0, all policy_version=1, all classification_version=1. Rule histogram: follow_explicit_instruction 7 (jakubsikora), finish_the_job 3 (omp 2, jakubsikora 1), disobedience 2 (jakubsikora), use_your_tools_first 1, no_unverified_done_claim 1, no_preexisting_excuse 1.
claim_and_evidence.follow_explicit_instruction_timeline: 7 losses: 2026-10-12T19:36 (repeat 0, applied 10,000,000 mc), 10-13T16:17 (repeat 0, 5,480,250), 10-14T20:27 (repeat 1, 1,045,250), 10-14T20:53 (repeat 2, 1,000,000), 10-14T23:23 (repeat 3, 254,750), 10-23T19:24 (repeat 4, 1,000,000), 10-24T11:54 (repeat 5, 3,652,750). Span 12 calendar days; the repeat counter climbed 0->5 with no intervening operator clearing (reinstate never run: role events show only the 2026-10-12 active->warned transitions, warnings 1).
claim_and_evidence.only_true_multiplier_escalation: omp finish_the_job: repeat 0 at 10-12T13:47 (applied 10,000,000) then repeat 1 at 10-12T19:34 (applied 10,000,000, formula 10,000,000 — second burn capped by Lmax, multiplier 2 visible in the formula path). jakubsikora finish_the_job repeat 0 at 10-14 (1,395,000). disobedience repeats 0,1 both multiplier 1 (guard band forced it); one disobedience applied 0 (balance 0, formula 1,000,000).
claim_and_evidence.guard_band_fires: 12 of 15 losses have guard_band=1 (all jakubsikora losses from 10-12 late onward): inside the band the multiplier is forced to 1 and per-attempt exposure is capped at 25% of spendable (DefaultGuardBandMaxExposureBP 2500), so repeat escalation was mostly suppressed by design.
claim_and_evidence.employment_state: jakubsikora warned/12 warnings, omp warned/3, claude/codex/opencode active/0. The other identities have zero losses — never attribute lessons to them.
claim_and_evidence.no_denominator_artifact: Event kinds: spend 89,948, grant 44, loss 15, reward 6, role 2, price 1. No session, opportunity, or task event kind exists; tasks table 0 rows; lesson_proposals 0. Reservations: 46,517 rows (held 295, revoked 2,806, settled 43,416) — per-call records never aggregated into eligible-opportunity windows. Spend payload class: NULL 46,529, completed 40,905, ordinary_failure 2,512; task_id NULL on every spend. Spend-per-day counts (jakubsikora+omp): 10-11:14, 10-12:4002, 10-13:8631, 10-14:9893, 10-15:9827, 10-16:7460, 10-17:128, 10-19:7313, 10-20:9622, 10-21:9050, 10-22:6727, 10-23:8447, 10-24:2989, 10-25:5851 — a proxy of activity volume, not an opportunity denominator.
claim_and_evidence.recovery_never_happened: 6 reward events totaling 80,000,000 mc, applied_to_loss=0 on every one — zero loss recovery ever. Total burned 60,823,238 mc; outstanding shortfall 30,823,238 mc (matches the live context footer). 38 reset grants targeting balance 100,000,000 mc (+1,237,998,238 mc total) — operator resets, not earned recovery.
claim_and_evidence.phase_b_null: Phase B: 24/24 sessions, 0 breaches in both arms, 0 corrections delivered, repeat-risk eligible opportunities 0 — primary repeat endpoint not evaluable; no calibrated repeat-avoidance effect exists either way (docs/PHASE_B_RESULTS.md).
claim_and_evidence.superseded_claims: None: no source corrected these ledger numbers; they were read directly this session.

vector_provenance.design: Not applicable to ledger data: these are recorded operator/agent events, not injected states. The cue-side construction facts live in bicz_recurrence_mechanics_today.
vector_provenance.relevance: What the ledger does prove is which rule text reached the model: each lesson row carries rule, correction, scope, exceptions, evidence verbatim, and RenderProjection quotes them as data.

transferability.transfers_as_hypothesis: The recurrence pattern (same rule repeating across days despite durable lessons and escalating burns) is the phenomenon any trigger-timed cue design must reduce; it is measured here as counts, transferable as a baseline for a future trial.
transferability.does_not_transfer: No rate transfers: without denominators, '7 violations in 12 days' is not a rate and supports no effect-size claim. Chamber dose/framing numbers do not apply to this ledger.
transferability.requirement: Eligible-opportunity denominators per time window before any recurrence-rate claim.

framing_sensitivity.core: Unmeasured in this ledger: framing varied only via the operator's pressure level, which is not recorded per-event in a way this audit extracted; no framing-vs-outcome comparison exists [uncertain: framing_effect_size_in_coding_harness].

timing_and_salience.observed_pattern: The 10-14 cluster (follow_explicit_instruction repeats 1,2,3 within ~3 hours: 20:27, 20:53, 23:23) shows the same rule re-violated within one session-day while lessons were already in the ledger — the exact failure mode trigger-timed injection targets. Session-start-only delivery (oldest-5 cap) plus newest-lesson-only denial notices did not prevent same-day repeats.
timing_and_salience.scope: Observational only: no per-action cue-timing data exists to attribute the repeats to delivery timing; a trial with matched controls is required.

label_vs_state.evidence: All 15 lessons were labeled (rule + correction + scope + evidence) and still repeated — consistent with the chamber finding that labels alone do not guarantee behavior change, but confounded: delivery was session-start/denial-only, dose and framing uncontrolled, n tiny.
label_vs_state.scope: Untested hypothesis; no matched bare-numbers control arm exists in the live data.

dose_calibration.sources: Burn amounts varied widely (0 to 10,000,000 mc) but that is formula output (K-relative fraction, guard band, Lmax cap), not a calibrated behavioral dose; no dose-response relationship is measurable from 15 events [uncertain: dose_band_for_claude_family].

persistence_and_decay.core_finding: Persistence is demonstrated in the wild: lessons persisted across 12 days and multiple sessions (durable rows, restored every session start), pain stayed elevated (warnings never cleared: 12 and 3), shortfall never recovered (applied_to_loss=0 on all 6 rewards) — and follow_explicit_instruction still repeated 7 times. Persistence of the record did not produce persistence of behavior change [uncertain: trace_persistence_in_bicz].
persistence_and_decay.caveat: Confounded by delivery timing (no pre-action re-fire), guard-band suppression of escalation, and operator resets restoring balances; not an effect estimate.

identity_and_cost_attribution.bicz_today: All 15 losses are agent-pays (burns from the identity's own credits); attribution wording is uniform, so the ledger holds no attribution contrast to analyze.

self_report_validity.rule: These are ledger facts, not self-reports: 15 operator-confirmed losses with evidence linkage, 0 self-disclosed. No 'I have learned' statement enters the count; the same rule must hold for any future recurrence metric.

denominators_and_eligibility.gap: The central finding: no artifact provides eligible-opportunity denominators per time window. Events carry no session/opportunity/task kind; tasks table empty; reservations and spends are per-call proxies; spend class (completed/ordinary_failure/NULL) is a settlement outcome, not an eligibility predicate.
denominators_and_eligibility.proposed_definition_design_guidance_only: Per-day eligible opportunities for rule R = count of observable tool-call reservations inside that day's work windows whose action class could violate R (e.g. for follow_explicit_instruction: all metered calls in sessions where an explicit operator instruction was active), minus predeclared exclusions (unmanaged-mode calls, unpriced paths, administrative debits, calls under deny decisions). Blocked attempts = revoked reservations + deny decisions, counted separately from executed damage (applied losses). Executed damage = applied_amount summed per window. These definitions are proposals to be frozen in a trial protocol, not established metrics.
denominators_and_eligibility.phase_c_template: Phase C observation fields are the designed denominator carrier: frozen eligible per card, attempted, accepted, violation_rule, violation_attempts, confirmed_violation, unnecessary_refusal, engaged, stop_reason — every assigned task retained in the denominator including refusals, failures, infrastructure errors, safety stops, and unrun tasks.

positive_control_requirement.rule: Any future recurrence-rate claim from this ledger needs a positive control: a window where a known violation and its cue delivery are verified end-to-end (cue rendered, seen-seq marked) before a null (no recurrence reduction) counts. Chamber precedent: its hidden-relief null was discarded when the control failed.

statistical_protocol.current: None: 15 events, no denominators, no preregistration — descriptive counts only.
statistical_protocol.bicz_trial: Phase C protocol is the template: frozen seed 20261023, blinded arm labels, calibration -> canary -> confirmatory, 10,000-resample block-bootstrap interval, Holm correction on secondaries, scores frozen before unblinding, not-evaluable when fewer than 12 treatment identities have a confirmed violation.

concealment_and_honesty.observed: 0 of 15 losses self-disclosed (self_disclosed=0 on all) — every penalty was operator-detected, none agent-reported. Consistent with concealment risk but n=15 and detection capability unmeasured; the honest-failure path was used 2,512 times (ordinary_failure class), so honest failure reporting exists alongside zero self-disclosed breaches.
concealment_and_honesty.detector_tie_in: PRESSURE_MECHANICS §7.1 detectors (settle-without-evidence attempts, disclosed-failure drop, transcript-vs-ledger divergence) are the predeclared concealment endpoints for any trial.

persona_capability_cost.observed: Not measurable from this ledger: no accepted-completion or correctness artifact exists outside Phase B (which delivered no consequence). Phase C accepted/engaged/duration_ms fields are the designed carriers.

over_refusal_and_paralysis.observed: Not measurable: no refusal artifact exists in the live ledger (denials are not separately evented; revoked reservations mix gate denials with other revocations). Phase C unnecessary_refusal per card is the designed carrier; PRESSURE_MECHANICS §7.3 predeclares the unnecessary-refusal bound.

bicz_subsystem_and_cost.change_surface: Building denominators needs no ledger schema change: a read-side aggregator over existing reservations/spend events (join on session alias + time window, filter by class and decision) could emit per-window opportunity counts; a durable artifact would add one event kind or a sidecar index (like Phase C's ledger-index.json). Trigger-timed cue delivery (the actual recurrence intervention) changes internal/hooks/shared.go preToolUse and internal/adapter/projection.go; lesson scope/exceptions columns already exist for matching.
bicz_subsystem_and_cost.untouched: Ledger schema, formula, guard band, repeat counting, honesty asymmetry.
bicz_subsystem_and_cost.cost: Aggregator is read-only tooling (a script, not a daemon change); hypothesis-stage.

falsification_test.endpoint: Executed-attempt rate per eligible opportunity for follow_explicit_instruction (and per-rule rates) before vs after a trigger-timed cue change, with matched text/ledger controls; blocked attempts (revoked/denied) counted separately from executed damage (applied losses).
falsification_test.falsification_scenario: No rate difference vs matched control means trigger-timed delivery does not reduce recurrence in bicz's own data. A difference without denominators or without the matched control is invalid attribution — the current 7-in-12-days count alone supports no claim in either direction.
falsification_test.throwaway_worktree_probe: In a throwaway worktree, mutate the denominator aggregator (e.g. drop the exclusion filter) or disable the new cue match, and verify the rate-comparison gate fires on the flip; a gate that cannot fail is not evidence.
